description: This file contains API route handlers for managing development plans within a FastAPI web application. It defines endpoints for generating a development plan based on identified gaps and exporting the plan as a link, including logic for creating steps and handling database transactions.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlan
classes.description: ORM model representing a development plan for a user, containing steps and associated user/target role IDs.

classes.name: AuditLog
classes.description: ORM model for logging user actions such as plan creation and export.

classes.name: User
classes.description: ORM model for user data, used for authentication and association with plans.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlanCreate
classes.description: Pydantic schema for creating a new development plan, includes a list of gaps and target role ID.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlanRead
classes.description: Pydantic schema for returning a development plan, including its steps and metadata.

classes.name: PlanExportRequest
classes.description: Pydantic schema for request to export a plan, including format and optional plan ID.

classes.name: PlanExportResponse
classes.description: Pydantic schema for the export URL response.

classes.name: PlanStep
classes.description: Schema representing individual steps in a development plan.

methods.name: List[PlanStep] _generate_steps_from_gaps(gaps: list)
methods.description: Creates a list of PlanStep objects based on gaps, producing actionable steps for skill development.

methods.name: DevelopmentPlanRead generate_development_plan( payload: DevelopmentPlanCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to generate and save a new development plan based on provided gaps.

methods.name: PlanExportResponse export_development_plan( payload: PlanExportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to generate a URL for exporting the development plan, either recent or specified.

ctags.name: export_development_plan
ctags.signature: ( payload: PlanExportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: generate_development_plan
ctags.signature: ( payload: DevelopmentPlanCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
